name: Yeasin Geo-Blocker
author: Yeasin

sections.description:
Yeasin Geo-Blocker is an enterprise-grade security plugin that empowers you to control exactly who accesses your WordPress website based on their geographical location.

Unlike other plugins that rely on slow, rate-limited external APIs, this plugin utilizes a highly optimized local MaxMind database. This guarantees lightning-fast IP processing, zero rate limits, and maximum privacy for your site’s traffic.

🛡️ Core Free Features

  • Country-Level Blocking: Create a strict Whitelist or Blacklist for specific countries.
  • Manual IP Management: Explicitly block or allow specific IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
  • Frontend & Backend Protection: Secure your public website, your wp-admin dashboard, or both simultaneously.
  • Local Database Engine: Powered by a local GeoLite2 database for zero-latency lookups.
  • SEO Bot Bypass: Allow essential search engine crawlers (Google, Bing, Yahoo) to bypass geo-restrictions safely.
  • Cloudflare & Proxy Support: Automatically detects the true origin IP behind Cloudflare and proxy headers.
  • Visual Editor Integration: Style your blocked access message and footer branding using the WordPress visual editor (bold, colors, links).
  • Real-Time Analytics Table: View a paginated log of the last 100 blocked threats directly in a dedicated dashboard tab.

🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Take your site’s security and regional traffic management to the next level with our premium upgrade.

  • General Geo-Blocking Rules: Restrict access completely by Country, State, or City.
  • Smart URL Redirects: Automatically send users from specific regions to different URLs.
  • Restricting WooCommerce: Hide products, checkouts, or specific payment gateways by location.
  • Geo-Dynamic Content Shortcodes: Hide/Show Elementor Widgets or use shortcodes based on location.
  • VPN, Tor, API Blocking & Anti-DDoS: Block VPNs, Tor networks, API attacks, and limit rate requests.
  • Generating Secret Bypass Links: Generate custom tokens to allow team members to bypass blocks.
  • Customizing the Block Page Design: Apply Preset Themes, custom logos, and typography to the block screen.
  • Viewing Analytics and Exporting Logs: Monitor all blocked attempts with precise locations and export to CSV.
  • MaxMind Auto-Sync for 100% Accuracy: Get automated weekly database updates for perfect IP accuracy.

External services

This plugin utilizes a local MaxMind database for lightning-fast IP lookups. However, if the local database file is missing or corrupted, the plugin relies on a fallback connection to a free external geolocation API to ensure your site remains protected.

It sends the visitor’s IP address to this service only when the local database fails. This fallback service is provided by IP-API:
* Terms of Use: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal
* Privacy Policy: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal
sections.installation:
1. Upload the yeasin-geo-blocker directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new ‘Geo-Blocker’ menu in your admin dashboard to configure your settings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Feature: Added visual text editors for customizing the blocked message and footer text.
  • Feature: Separated Access Logs into a dedicated tab with pagination (up to 100 recent logs).
  • Enhancement: Modularized admin architecture using separate PHP files for tabs.
  • Enhancement: Integrated AJAX form submission for a seamless, page-reload-free saving experience.
  • Enhancement: Made the entire admin dashboard fully responsive with a 35% global sidebar layout for larger screens.
  • Tweak: Updated plugin action links and meta links layout.
  • Tweak: Added plugin version number to the dashboard header.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Core geo-blocking engine, local database integration, and premium UI setup.
